verdict.rationale: Postman CLI docs explicitly state you can 'Create, manage, and forward webhooks for event-driven integrations and local development,' directly matching the story of subscribing to events via webhooks. This is documented as a first-party CLI capability usable in automated/agentic workflows, though it's a single doc mention without deeper hands-on or independent corroboration. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of webhook subscription workflows, more detailed docs on webhook event types/payloads, and confirmation of AI-agent-specific webhook subscription flows.
